prototype: TICVAI Guest Booking Mobile v2.dc.html (same app packed as "TICVAI Guest Booking Mobile v2 (single file).html")
rev: Client rev 3 (feedback 25 Sep; flow review and updates 28 Sep; handoff exported 27–28 Sep)
howToOpen: Open "TICVAI Guest Booking Mobile v2 (single file).html" in a browser, tap the Account tab, then "All screens" (Wave 1/2/3 and "Rev 3 feedback · 25 screens"). Booking flows open the embedded web engine from Discover → a venue.

screens.name: Home – Default
screens.view: Discover tab (Home)
screens.evidence: isHome template: "Evening, Layla", "Where to" venue cards (Summit Peaks, Union Arena, Coastal Aqua, Grand Playhouse, Saffron Table), "Tonight"; dir row "Home" → #home
screens.differences: Home carries an "At venue mode is live" banner and the EN/العربية language button; no search box on home (search is reached from the listing). YAML reads listMyEntitlements but the prototype home shows no ticket strip.

screens.view: Account → All screens → Wave 1 → Explore categories
screens.evidence: scrDefs.explore "Explore": grid Rides, Shows, Water, Food & drink, Kids, Shop, Parking, Memberships
screens.differences: Tiles also jump to F&B, Retail, Parking and Memberships, not only to listing/details as the YAML navigation says.

screens.differences: Rev 3 adds "Ticket categories" (category → subcategory) and "Experiences, product first" listings which the YAML does not describe.

screens.evidence: scrDefs.attraction "Desert Coaster": queue 25 min, minimum height 1.30 m, Fast Track, "Join the virtual queue"

screens.name: Select Date & Time
screens.view: Account → All screens → Wave 1 → Select date & time; Rev 3 feedback → Performance times; live flow: Discover → venue → Booking (embedded web engine)
screens.evidence: scrDefs.datetime "Select date & time" (15:00 "Sold out" → "Waitlist"); r3perf "Step 1 · Date / Step 2 · Time of day", "Morning · page 1 of 3"; #book → iframe "TICVAI Guest Booking v2.dc.html?embed=mobile"
screens.differences: Rev 3 adds date → time → ticket reveal, a morning/afternoon/evening filter with counts, paging of long time lists, a waitlist on sold-out times, and per-flow variants (guided tour by language, surf session filters, swim consent pop-up, location switcher, quick tour). None of these (paging, part-of-day filter, waitlist, language filter) are in the YAML.

screens.name: Tickets & Add-ons

screens.differences: The YAML (transferOrderTickets only) and the Wave 1 prototype screen both treat this as tickets-with-transfer after purchase, but the name and the Rev 3 flow mean choosing ticket types and add-ons during booking. Rev 3 also moves all add-ons to one Add-ons step. The YAML needs a definition for selection and add-ons (listProducts/addCartLine).

summary: 71 screens: 61 exact, 10 partial, 0 none. The six deferred screens (GST-030, 051-054, 059) are all still drawn in the prototype. 13 unmapped views, mostly Rev 3 flows (multi-location, categories and info-only products, help me choose, meeting room, intercity transport). Top differences: (1) Booking steps. Rev 3 reveals date, then time, then ticket, pages long time lists with part-of-day filters, puts a date/time pop-up and a time bar on the seat map, and moves every add-on to one step. GST-007, GST-008 and GST-049 have none of this, and GST-008 is defined as ticket transfer rather than choosing tickets and add-ons. (2) The prototype contradicts settled decisions: guests book cabanas from a map (GST-050/058/070, against R073c staff-only), tables take deposits (GST-017/070, against R077a), Security offers two-step verification (GST-073, against R167), and it shows the in-venue notifications feed that R242 defers (GST-030). (3) Sign-in and checkout. In the prototype, Checkout entry is a choice between signing in and guest checkout (email code, Apple, Google), asked after Add-ons. The YAML GST-041 is a cart screen, and GST-042 also has password and UAE Pass, which the prototype does not show. The prototype also labels the privacy screen GST-070.
